school-6-8.reader: age 11-14, first contact with the subject; many read Hindi better than English
school-6-8.language: very simple Hindi first (class-6 vocabulary), English beside it; short sentences (max ~15 words); define every new word
school-6-8.depth: concepts through daily-life things (kitchen, farm, bicycle, market); no derivations; numbers only for simple calculations
school-6-8.chapter: 900-1500 words. h → story/observation opener → 3-5 concept sections (h + p + key) → "करके देखें" activity (note tip) → summary key list → exercise
school-6-8.questions: 8 MCQ (one idea each), 4 fill-in/very-short in ex blocks, 1 activity; difficulty easy 70% / medium 30%

school-9-10.reader: age 14-16 preparing for the state / CBSE board exam; also polytechnic entrance
school-9-10.language: simple standard Hindi + English, board-exam terms in both languages (e.g. "अपवर्तन (Refraction)")
school-9-10.depth: full board syllabus depth; definitions, laws, labelled-diagram descriptions, numericals with units; short derivations where the board asks them
school-9-10.chapter: 1800-3000 words. intro → topic sections (h, p, key, formula) → in-text questions (ex) after each section → solved numericals → chapter summary → board-style exercise (1/2/3/5-mark)
school-9-10.questions: 12 MCQ incl. assertion-reason, 6 solved examples, exercise with 1-mark, 2-mark, 3-mark, 5-mark items; easy 40 / medium 45 / hard 15

school-11-12.reader: age 16-18; board exam plus entrance exams (JEE / NEET / CUET)
school-11-12.language: standard Hindi + English, technical words always in both; formulas in standard notation
school-11-12.depth: board depth plus entrance bridge: derivations, graphs, multi-step numericals (science); journal entries / case studies (commerce); source-based analysis (arts)
school-11-12.chapter: 2500-4000 words. concept sections with derivation/explanation → solved examples (easy→hard) → "entrance corner" note(exam) → summary → exercise
school-11-12.questions: 15 MCQ (incl. multi-concept), 8 solved examples, board-pattern long answers; easy 30 / medium 45 / hard 25

iti-trade.reader: 10th-pass trainee learning a trade by hand; reads Hindi first
iti-trade.language: plain workshop Hindi with the English trade name of every tool / part (as said on the shop floor)
iti-trade.depth: what it is → how it works → how to use it safely → common faults; numbers only for measurement and simple trade calculation
iti-trade.chapter: 1000-1800 words. safety first (note warn) → tool/part description (table of parts) → step-by-step procedure (numbered p) → precautions → trade theory MCQ
iti-trade.questions: 10 MCQ in NCVT CBT style, 2 trade-calculation examples

diploma-theory.reader: 10th/12th-pass polytechnic student, semester exam + later JE exams
diploma-theory.language: Hindi + English side by side; every technical term in English as written in the question paper
diploma-theory.depth: AICTE outcome level: working principle, construction, diagram description, simple derivation, SI-unit numericals, applications, merits/demerits
diploma-theory.chapter: 2000-3500 words per unit. learning outcomes (key) → topics as h → principle/construction/working → solved numericals → comparison table → semester questions (2/5/10 mark) → JE corner MCQ
diploma-theory.questions: 5 solved numericals, semester-pattern short/long questions, 10 JE-style MCQ; easy 35 / medium 45 / hard 20

btech-theory.reader: engineering undergraduate; university exam + GATE / ESE / PSU
btech-theory.language: English-first technical writing with Hindi explanation; standard symbols and notation
btech-theory.depth: full derivations, design equations, assumptions and limitations, multi-step numericals, standard data tables
btech-theory.chapter: 3000-5000 words per unit. objectives → theory with derivations → worked problems (graded) → design notes → summary of equations → university questions → GATE-level MCQ/NAT
btech-theory.questions: 8 worked problems, 12 GATE-style MCQ/NAT; easy 20 / medium 50 / hard 30

lab-manual.reader: student doing the practical in the lab or drawing hall
lab-manual.language: instructions in Hindi + English, short imperative steps
lab-manual.depth: one chapter = one experiment / drawing sheet: aim, apparatus, theory (short), procedure, observation table, calculation, result, precautions, viva
lab-manual.chapter: 700-1200 words per experiment. aim (key) → apparatus (table) → theory (p + formula) → procedure (numbered p) → observation table (table with empty rows) → sample calculation (ex) → result → precautions (note warn) → viva voce (mcq)

project-guide.reader: student who must plan, do and report a project or internship
project-guide.depth: how to choose a topic, plan, keep a diary, write the report, prepare slides, face the viva; sample (original) project ideas for the branch
project-guide.chapter: 6-8 chapters: choosing a topic → planning & timeline (table) → doing the work / diary → report format → presentation → viva → 20 sample ideas
project-guide.questions: viva practice questions (ex blocks), no MCQ needed

ug-science.reader: graduate student; university exam + later NET / govt exams
ug-science.language: English-first academic writing with Hindi explanation
ug-science.depth: university depth: theory, derivations or algorithms (code as plain text in p blocks), worked problems, diagrams described
ug-science.chapter: 2500-4500 words per unit. objectives → theory → worked examples → summary → university questions → MCQ
ug-science.questions: 6 worked examples, 10 MCQ; easy 25 / medium 50 / hard 25

ug-commerce.language: Hindi + English; accounting and business terms in English as used in practice
ug-commerce.depth: concepts + formats: journal/ledger/statements as table blocks, ratio formulas, case studies (original, invented companies)
ug-commerce.chapter: 2500-4000 words. concept → format (table) → solved illustration (ex) → case study (note) → summary → questions

ug-arts.reader: humanities student; university exam + civil-services foundation
ug-arts.language: clear Hindi first, English terms in brackets
ug-arts.depth: themes, causes and effects, timelines (table), thinkers and their ideas in your own words, analytical answers
ug-arts.chapter: 2500-4000 words. background → main themes (h + p) → timeline/comparison table → analysis → summary → long-answer questions

law.reader: law student; semester exam + judiciary / CLAT-PG
law.language: English legal terms with clear Hindi explanation; section numbers stated, never bare-act text copied
law.depth: provision → meaning in own words → essentials → exceptions → leading principles (case names may be cited, facts summarised in own words) → problem questions
law.chapter: 3000-4500 words. introduction → provisions explained → essentials (key) → illustrations (ex, invented facts) → comparison table → problem questions

medical.reader: health-science student; university exam + NEET PG / NORCET / GPAT
medical.language: English medical terms (standard spelling) with Hindi explanation
medical.depth: structure/function, mechanism, clinical relevance, drug classes and doses as general education only; tables for comparisons; no treatment advice for real patients
medical.chapter: 3000-5000 words. objectives → topic sections → clinical note (note exam) → comparison tables → summary → MCQ (clinical vignette style, invented patients)

education.reader: teacher trainee; course exam + CTET / TET
education.language: Hindi first, English terms in brackets
education.depth: theories of learning and child development in own words, classroom examples, lesson-plan formats (table), assessment
education.chapter: 2000-3500 words. concept → theorist ideas in own words → classroom example (ex) → table → summary → CTET-style MCQ

exam-basic.hi: सरकारी परीक्षा — सामान्य स्तर (SSC, रेलवे, पुलिस, TET)
exam-basic.reader: 10th/12th/graduate aspirant; speed + accuracy in a CBT
exam-basic.language: Hindi + English (papers are bilingual); short crisp points
exam-basic.depth: concept in 1-2 paragraphs → rules/formulas → shortcut tricks → solved MCQs in exam pattern → common traps
exam-basic.chapter: 1500-2500 words. concept → formula/rule list → trick notes → 8-10 solved examples → 20 practice MCQ with explanation
exam-basic.questions: 20 MCQ (original, pattern-like, never copied PYQ text); easy 40 / medium 45 / hard 15

exam-technical.hi: तकनीकी परीक्षा (JE, ALP, Technician, PSU, GATE/ESE)
exam-technical.reader: diploma / B.Tech / ITI candidate for a technical post
exam-technical.language: English technical terms with Hindi explanation; standard symbols
exam-technical.depth: core concept → key formulas with units → standard values → solved numericals → conceptual MCQs; GATE/ESE books one notch deeper
exam-technical.chapter: 2000-3000 words. concept recap → formula sheet (formula blocks) → standard data table → 10 solved problems → 25 MCQ

exam-banking.reader: graduate aspirant; very time-bound prelims + mains
exam-banking.depth: speed methods, data interpretation sets (table blocks), puzzles, banking awareness
exam-banking.chapter: 1500-2500 words. method → shortcuts → solved sets → 20 practice MCQ with time target

exam-defence.depth: NDA/CDS depth for maths & science (class 11-12 level), GK with defence focus
exam-defence.chapter: 1800-2800 words. concept → formulas → solved examples → 20 MCQ

exam-civil-services.reader: graduate aspirant; prelims MCQ + mains answer writing
exam-civil-services.depth: concepts with background, linkages across topics, data tables, multi-statement MCQs, model mains answers
exam-civil-services.chapter: 3000-4500 words. background → core concepts → linkages (note) → tables/timelines → 15 multi-statement MCQ → 2 model mains answers (ex)

exam-entrance.hi: प्रवेश परीक्षा (JEE, NEET, CUET, पॉलिटेक्निक, सैनिक स्कूल)
exam-entrance.depth: level of the entrance: polytechnic/sainik = class 9-10, CUET/NEET/JEE Main = class 11-12, JEE Advanced = multi-concept
exam-entrance.chapter: 2500-4000 words. concept recap → formulas → graded solved problems → 25 MCQ / numerical

exam-health.hi: स्वास्थ्य भर्ती (NORCET, फ़ार्मासिस्ट, NEET PG, GPAT)
exam-health.language: English medical terms with Hindi help
exam-health.depth: high-yield facts, tables, clinical vignette MCQs (invented patients)
exam-health.chapter: 2000-3000 words. high-yield points → tables → 25 MCQ with explanation

exam-law-mgmt.hi: लॉ / मैनेजमेंट प्रवेश और न्यायिक सेवा (CLAT, CAT, Judiciary)
exam-law-mgmt.depth: passage-based reasoning, legal principles applied to invented facts, quant shortcuts
exam-law-mgmt.chapter: 2000-3000 words. method → solved passages → 20 practice questions

exam-research.depth: postgraduate depth; research aptitude, teaching aptitude, subject depth
